_comment: Vehicles are content; the trucks in a convoy are instances (id, type, fitted upgrades) so an upgrade can sit on one truck and not another. resaleFraction is what the station pays back on a truck and on its upgrades. An upgrade names the kinds it fits; effects stack multiplicatively for speed and fuel and additively for capacity, upkeep and mine yield.

upgrades.name: Cargo Racks
upgrades.blurb: Bolt-on racking. More hold, nothing else changes.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Axles
upgrades.blurb: Carries a great deal more, a little slower.

upgrades.name: Turbo Kit
upgrades.blurb: Faster on every road; thirstier on every road.

upgrades.name: Economy Tune
upgrades.blurb: Retuned for the long haul. Cheaper to run, cheaper to feed.

upgrades.name: Auger Kit
upgrades.blurb: A bigger bit for the Digger. More ore per day on a claim.
